name: Commercial Plastics Corp.
old_description: Our dedicated professionals can custom-craft plastic products for retail, commercial, and industrial applications, including cutting boards, award cases, model boxes, signs, displays, and polycarbonate floor mats. We can also cut plastic to your exact specifications.
about:
Commercial Plastics Corp. operates from Arlington, Washington, where it has served the plastic fabrication market for over three decades. The company's history emphasizes deep industry experience rather than a specific founding date or ownership structure, and no individual founders are named in public materials.

The shop specializes in custom plastic fabrication and machining, working with materials such as acrylic, polycarbonate, ABS, and polyethylene. Its services range from precision cutting of sheet stock to full custom manufacturing of products including cutting boards, award cases, model boxes, signs, displays, and polycarbonate floor mats. The facility maintains a large inventory of plastic sheeting and supports volumes from single prototypes to large-scale assemblies, complemented by on-site storage and distribution.

Customers span marine, retail, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company cites work for marine applications alongside retail display and industrial component needs, indicating a broad base of B2B clients seeking tailored plastic parts.

Commercial Plastics positions itself as an all-in-one resource, combining skilled technicians, current technology, extensive sheet inventory, and integrated manufacturing, storage, and distribution under one roof. It highlights the ability to handle projects of any size and a commitment to close collaboration with clients to meet exact specifications.
